name: Event-Bench-Videos
description: A video dataset benchmark for event detection and recognition in short video clips, designed to evaluate models' ability to identify and classify temporally localized events. It includes annotated events across diverse settings to test temporal understanding, event localization, and multi-modal cues (visual and optionally audio). The benchmark supports evaluation of both classification and detection/localization algorithms.
reputation: A niche benchmark on Hugging Face with limited but growing use among researchers focusing on video event understanding.
